decisions.text: Use Qdrant (not LanceDB) as vector store — serverless local mode with hybrid RRF fusion
decisions.rationale: Already implemented, working. Hybrid search functional.

decisions.text: Batch embedding (8 files/batch, sequential) instead of ThreadPoolExecutor to avoid VRAM OOM
decisions.rationale: 32-thread ThreadPoolExecutor caused 26.4GB VRAM allocation on 12GB GPU.
FlagReranker crash proved we enable features without validating dependencies.

decisions.text: Flat task list for JSON orchestration (not nested hierarchical)
decisions.rationale: Research confirmed: flat arrays are simpler for LLM parsing, easier to enforce priority order.

decisions.text: Enable reranking via sentence_transformers.CrossEncoder, not FlagEmbedding
decisions.rationale: FlagEmbedding doesn't compile on Python 3.14/Windows. CrossEncoder verified working.

decisions.text: Local Ollama first — never rely on external free models (they rotate/deprecated)
decisions.rationale: OpenRouter free tier limited to 50 requests/day. Free models return 404 frequently.

decisions.text: gemma3:4b recommended as primary worker over gemma4-e4b until gemma4 patterns established
decisions.rationale: Research: gemma4-e4b has 18/42 shared KV layers + SWA(512) — less reliable tool-calling.

decisions.text: 3-layer enforcement: input rails, pre-execution validation, mandatory search-first protocol
decisions.rationale: Research paper: 'Simply instructing an agent to use files is insufficient; system must be architecturally constrained.'

decisions.text: Vault backups excluded from scanning — they duplicate current files and pollute search
decisions.rationale: Vault copies appeared in top 5 search results for 'FileMind configuration scan roots'.

decisions.text: Multi-model swarm architecture: Worker (gemma3:4b), Critic (qwen2.5:3b), Router (phi4:mini)
decisions.rationale: Research paper recommended this architecture. Total VRAM ~10GB fits in 12GB.

decisions.text: Smart chunking with file-type-aware dispatch (AST, structure, headers, layout)
decisions.rationale: Research PDF 'Beyond Fixed-Size Chunks' provided complete blueprint. Rebuild: 3,877 files, 5,896 chunks, 0 errors.

decisions.text: Qwen MUST NOT conduct deep research autonomously — generate research prompt and delegate to user's dedicated research agent
decisions.rationale: User directive: Qwen is the coding expert, not the researcher. Deep research requires dedicated agent with proper methodology.

decisions.text: Safety-first file organization: whitelist-based IMMUTABLES/PROTECTED/MOVABLES classification before any file movement
decisions.rationale: Moving wrong files could break Ollama, Kimi, Claude, or other agents. User concern: 'critical code mistakenly gets categorized'.

decisions.text: Future: Hierarchical Context-Directed Scanning (Phase 3+) — multi-pass scanning across drives, starting at top-level, using context to direct deeper scans
decisions.rationale: User has apps/games scattered across multiple drives. Goal: intelligent discovery without blind one-by-one scanning. Method: Pass 1 (top-level folders) → Pass 2 (context-directed) → Pass 3 (file-level, prioritized by size/likelihood) → Pass 4 (isolate app root from generic system dirs).
